explication: VibeUE is an Unreal Engine MCP expansion and AI editor toolset. The principal workflow is: an MCP-capable agent sends a call to Unreal’s native endpoint; VibeUE dispatches it through registered tools or Python execution; domain services inspect or mutate editor assets and sessions; results return through MCP. The graph preserves documented branches for terrain, authoring, profiling, workflows, skills, research, and Fab integration. Some subsystem links are based on README architecture because their implementation files were not sampled.
